H4210: properly, instrumental music; by implication, a poem set to notes
H1732: David, the youngest son of Jesse
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H7462: to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively, to graze (literally or figuratively); generally to rule; by extension, to associate with (as a friend)
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H2637: to lack; by implication, to fail, want, lessen
H7257: to crouch (on all four legs folded, like a recumbent animal); be implication, to recline, repose, brood, lurk, imbed
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H4325: water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen
H4496: repose or (adverbially) peacefully; figuratively, consolation (specifically, matrimony); hence (concretely) an abode
H5095: properly, to run with asparkle, i.e. flow; hence (transitively), to conduct, and (by inference) to protect, sustain
H5315: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
H7725: to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point); generally to retreat; often adverbial, again
H5148: to guide; by implication, to transport (into exile, or as colonists)
H4570: a track (literally or figuratively); also a rampart (as circular)
H6664: the right (natural, moral or legal); also (abstractly) equity or (figuratively) prosperity
H4616: properly, heed, i.e. purpose; used only adverbially, on account of (as a motive or an aim), teleologically, in order that
H8034: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
H1571: properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both...and
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H3212: to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively, to carry (in various senses)
H1516: a gorge (from its lofty sides; hence, narrow, but not a gully or winter-torrent)
H6757: shade of death, i.e. the grave (figuratively, calamity)
H3372: to fear; morally, to revere; caus. to frighten
H7451: bad or (as noun) evil (natural or moral)
H859: thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you
H7626: a scion, i.e. (literally) a stick (for punishing, writing, fighting, ruling, walking, etc.) or (figuratively) a clan
H4938: support (abstractly), i.e. (figuratively) sustenance or (concretely) a walking-stick
H5162: properly, to sigh, i.e. breathe strongly; by implication, to be sorry, i.e. (in a favorable sense) to pity, console or (reflexively) rue; or (unfavorably) to avenge (oneself)
H6186: to set in a row, i.e. arrange, put in order (in a very wide variety of applications)
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H7979: a table (as spread out); by implication, a meal
H5048: a front, i.e. part opposite; specifically a counterpart, or mate; usually (adverbial, especially with preposition) over against or before
H6887: to cramp, literally or figuratively, transitive or intransitive
H1878: to be fat; transitively, to fatten (or regard as fat); specifically to anoint; figuratively, to satisfy; to remove (fat) ashes (of sacrifices)
H8081: grease, especially liquid (as from the olive, often perfumed); figuratively, richness
H7218: the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, itc.)
H3563: a cup (as a container), often figuratively, a lot (as if a potion); also some unclean bird, probably an owl (perhaps from the cup-like cavity of its eye)
H389: a particle of affirmation, surely; hence (by limitation) only
H2896: good (as an adjective) in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun, both in the masculine and the feminine, the singular and the plural (good, a good or good thing, a good man or woman; the good, goods or good things, good men or women), also as an adverb (well)
H2617: kindness; by implication (towards God) piety; rarely (by opposition) reproof, or (subject.) beauty
H7291: to run after (usually with hostile intent; figuratively (of time) gone by)
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H2416: alive; hence, raw (flesh); fresh (plant, water, year), strong; also (as noun, especially in the feminine singular and masculine plural) life (or living thing), whether literally or figuratively
H3427: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry
H1004: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
